column1: # L40S run 2, 2026-08-23 -- one row per benchmark level.
# TRANSCRIBED, not captured. Every field below was read off the "Serving Benchmark
# Result" block that `vllm bench serve` printed to the terminal. The machine-written
# artefacts -- 22 result JSONs, 22 tee'd stdout files, 8 server logs and the 4 105-line
# metrics trace -- were left on the RunPod network volume at /workspace/run2, which was
# deliberately NOT deleted at terminate. They are the primary record; this file is a
# derivative and loses only the per-request arrays, which no figure here uses.
# rate "inf" means a closed loop (--request-rate inf --max-concurrency N).
# goodput is `--goodput ttft:300 tpot:50` in req/s; "-" where the flag was not passed.
# All times in milliseconds. Output length 200 tokens, --ignore-eos, everywhere.
